title: Four regional rail operators, financial year 2025
bodyMd: The table below summarises the 2025 results of the four rail operators licensed in the Vetrana region. Passenger numbers are in millions of journeys, revenue is passenger revenue in millions of euros, and the last column gives the share of trains that arrived on time.

data.caption: Vetrana regional rail operators, 2025: passenger journeys, passenger revenue and punctuality.

accessibilityText: A table of four rows and four columns. The columns are operator name, passengers in millions of journeys, passenger revenue in millions of euros, and the percentage of trains on time. Alba Regionale: 12 million journeys, 96 million euros, 88 per cent on time. Bora Rail: 25 million journeys, 150 million euros, 82 per cent on time. Cedro Linee: 8 million journeys, 72 million euros, 91 per cent on time. Dora Ferrovie: 15 million journeys, 90 million euros, 79 per cent on time. The four operators together carried 60 million journeys and earned 408 million euros. An accompanying bar chart plots passenger revenue only, one bar per operator, with the tallest bar for Bora Rail at 150 million euros and the shortest for Cedro Linee at 72 million euros.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional region and four fictional operators, written for this item set. The figures were chosen so that every ratio a question asks for is a whole or one-decimal number computable by hand without a calculator. Not derived from any real operator, dataset or published test item.
